EmailTemplate.name: Specific Needs Email Enquiry Bounce back Email template
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Enquiry with Qantas
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
Please Note: This inbox is not monitored, so please refrain from replying directly to this email.
Thanks for contacting us. We couldn’t find the Specific Needs case you require help with. To help you further, please follow the steps below.
If you have an existing case number:
1. Please reply directly to the email we sent previously, which can be identified by the subject line: Qantas Customer Specific Needs – Case Number. Our team will prioritise your request and be in touch as soon as possible.
For your email to reach us, please read these tips:
Ensure the email is sent from the same email address you used when you initially submitted your case.
Avoid editing any part of the original email from us, including the subject line, when replying to our original email.
2. Alternatively, you can visit Qantas Specific Needs for additional assistance.
If this is a new case, or if you can’t find your case number or original email:
The best way for us to assist you is via Qantas Specific Needs or by creating a new case through the Accessibility, Medical and Inclusion request form online or contacting us directly by phone.
Thank you for your patience as we work to resolve your enquiry.
Kind regards,
Qantas Customer Specific Needs
